name: Fairy Hill Park Playground
description: Fairy Hill Park is one of Greenwich's Green Flag Award-winning sites. The Green Chain Walk runs through this medium-sized park that is made up of a large area of grassland ideal for informal ball games, a children's playground and a small wooded area.
